note: How each colour set of sheet ColorSearchSet(DSC) finds its elements. Names and RGB come from the workbook (generate-color-sets.py); this file only says WHICH elements. Keys: discipline (role codes of that discipline unless roles narrows them), categories (Revit Element > Category, * = any), conditions (property keys of hp-base-sets.json; op equals/notEquals/like/atLeast; values = alternatives), alsoCategories (no conditions), verified (true = counted on a real model), pending (no reliable rule yet: the set is not created and is reported). The element's System Type property is an element reference (not text), so systems are matched on the System Type tab's Name (property key systemType, by display name) — verified 8/8 against THCSLT counts. Project abbreviations (THCSLT, confirmed by the user 2026-10-10): SH soil, TP and TNT waste, TN(BM) kitchen, TNM rain, TH vent, CNL / CN-L cold water; cable trays split by model (EC, EF = ELV; EE = LV).
